propositions: scc_loc.analyze() invokes scc subprocess with --format json and parses per-file Code and Location fields into AnalyzerResult.loc payload keyed by repo-relative POSIX paths with max_loc derived from max file LOC
Missing scc binary (FileNotFoundError), non-zero exit, empty stdout, or unparseable JSON each return Unavailable(reason, _ACCRUING_SINCE) and log warning without crash or fabricated zeros
Successful empty scc output (empty JSON array or no files) returns AnalyzerResult with empty files dict and max_loc=0, not Unavailable

scc_loc module stays self-contained in analyzers/ package with injectable subprocess runner parameter, avoiding cross-layer coupling to grounding layer while parsing the same two-level scc JSON structure (data list of language groups each with Files array)
